entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call is important to us. Please wait for the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is David. How can I help you today?
Hi David... I'm calling about an order. I bought a jersey a while back, and I was so excited for it, but... it's just not right.
I'm sorry to hear that. I can definitely look into it for you. To clarify, is there a technical fault with the jersey, or is it more of a preference issue?
Oh, it's the size. I must have ordered the wrong size. It's just way too tight, and I feel awful about it. I've been a loyal customer for years and I've never had this problem before.
I understand, that can certainly be disappointing. Let's see what we can do. Do you have your order number handy?
Yes, it's VF-8675309. I feel so bad for not trying it on sooner, I've just been so busy. I was really hoping I could get the money back, things are a bit tight this time of year.
Thank you. Let me pull that up... Okay, I see the order for the Pro-Line jersey, delivered on October 17th. That was 69 days ago. Let me just check our policy.
Oh, has it been that long? I'm so sorry. I hope it's not too late.
No problem at all. According to our policy, standard items like this jersey are eligible for return within 90 days. So you are well within the window. We can definitely process this for you.
Oh, really? That's... that's a huge relief. Thank you.
Of course. Would you prefer a full refund back to your original payment method, or would you like to do an exchange for a different size?
An exchange would be wonderful, actually. I do love the jersey, it was just the wrong size. How does that work?

Great. I'm initiating the exchange for you now and I'll email you a prepaid shipping label. Just package the original item, attach the label, and drop it at any post office. Once we see it's in transit, we'll ship out the new size to you.
That's perfect. Thank you so much, David. You've really helped me out today.
You're very welcome. Is there anything else I can assist you with?
My pleasure. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a great day.
